summary: iter65 — End-to-end multi-device login approval flow validated GREEN. Backend: 5/5 NEW iter65 pytest pass (approve, deny, expired, email binding, 409 mismatch) + 6/6 iter63 regression still pass. Full E2E flow verified: PC active session for devA → mobile login on devB returns HTTP 202 with detail.request_id + Mongo session_requests doc has status='pending', requesting_key_id='iter65_devB...', email matches, TTL = created_at + 15min (±10s tolerance). PC calls /auth/session-decide with Bearer token (devA's session_token) → status='approved'. Mobile polls /auth/session-request-status → 200 + status='approved' + session_token + user data; new user_sessions doc created with device_key_id='iter65_devB...'. Idempotency confirmed (2nd poll returns same token). Deny path: status='denied' returned to mobile, no session_token issued. Expiration: a pre-inserted request with expires_at = -1min auto-flips to 'expired' on first poll and DB is updated. Device-email binding: after a 200 login, device_keys.email is updated to the user's email. Mismatch: same key_id with different email → 409 'déjà lié à un autre compte (email_a)'. Frontend (mobile 412x915): /login mounts clean, no 'session expir' toast on fresh load OR after ?reason=session_expired (URL stripped to /login). localStorage codeforge_ideas_sort_kind / codeforge_ideas_sort_date round-trip works. IdeasButton.jsx source review confirms: (a) NO 'ideas-filter-all' data-testid (removed), (b) both 'ideas-sort-by-kind' and 'ideas-sort-by-date' testids present in adjacent flex-row, (c) onChange handlers are mutually exclusive (setSortByKind(true);setSortByDate(false) and vice-versa), (d) default sortByDate = localStorage.getItem('codeforge_ideas_sort_date') !== '0' → true on first load (no storage entry), (e) useEffect persists both keys on state change. Live creator-panel DOM exercise still blocked by Login readonly-autofill anti-bot trick (carried-over annoyance from iter63/iter64); source inspection + headless localStorage round-trip cover the contract.
action_items: No fixes required. The user-reported 'mobile login does not work' is NOT reproducible at backend or frontend level: (a) the full multi-device approve/deny/expire backend flow is verified end-to-end (5/5 pytest), (b) /login on mobile viewport 412x915 renders clean with zero residual 'session expirée' toast, (c) URL strip on ?reason=session_expired works. The user's issue is most likely client-side: stale localStorage/sessionStorage from a pre-iter64 build (pre-migration sessionStorage→localStorage) OR a PWA service-worker cache. Recommend the main agent ask the user to confirm via DevTools→Application→Clear storage on the offending phone, OR add a one-shot version-busting key (e.g. localStorage.setItem('codeforge_build', 'iter65')) that wipes legacy pendingApproval entries with the old schema on first paint.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L4933-4938 — expire-on-read pattern is correct: if status=='pending' and now>expires_at, flip to 'expired' BEFORE returning. Returns 'expired' on poll. Validated.

server.py L4949-4964 — issued_session_token is persisted on the session_request doc itself so concurrent polls return the same token (idempotency). Read-after-write guard (3×50ms) covers replica lag. Validated.
server.py L1335-1342 — device_keys.email binding happens AFTER all 202/409 gating, so binding only refreshes on a fully-successful 200 login. Correct ordering.
server.py L1258-1270 — stale-binding fallback (clear email if owner user no longer exists) is necessary for account-deletion churn; already tested by iter63::test_stale_binding_is_cleared.
IdeasButton.jsx L44-49 — defaults are sortByKind=false (when key missing) and sortByDate=true (because '!== "0"'). User spec: 'Trier par date ACTIF par défaut au premier load' → CONFIRMED.

IdeasButton.jsx L228, L240 — mutual exclusivity via `setSortByKind(true); setSortByDate(false)` and vice-versa. Both can NOT be false simultaneously if the user re-clicks the active one (checkbox stays bound to state); minor UX nuance: user cannot DISABLE BOTH, only flip between them. This is the intended 'mutually exclusive radio-like behaviour' from spec.
IdeasButton.jsx — 'ideas-filter-all' testid is GONE (grep shows zero occurrences). 'Tout cocher/décocher' button completely removed per spec.
